adjudication.rationale: The diff verifiably removes the `method_option :category` flag and the associated `category_id` lookup/assignment in `lib/tasks/disqus.thor`, and replaces the `PostCreator` call (which passed `category: category_id`) with `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, which does not accept/forward any category. This is a behavioral regression for the Disqus importer: callers can no longer specify a category and existing scripts using `--category` will break.
